mapper.select: select f.f_no, f.f_image, f.f_info, f.f_price, p.p_name, p.p_price, p.p_no from tea_favorite f join tea_product p on f.p_no = p.p_no where f.m_no = #{m_no}
mapper.insert: insert into tea_favorite(f_no, f_image, f_info, f_price, f_date, m_no, p_no) values(tea_favorite_seq.NEXTVAL, #{f_image}, #{f_info}, #{f_price}, SYSDATE, #{m_no}, #{p_no})
